title: Leave the EVA cages in place when a poll changes nothing
goal: The dashboard updates the EVA cages only when their state changes, so the images never reload for nothing
acceptance: A committed test fails first: rendering the cages twice with the same state writes the DOM once
A changed state still updates the cages
privacy: Neutral invented machine and job names only.
escalation: A change to how the cages look goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: find the poll re-render, a no-change guard and a failing-first render test. Not a measurement.
